text:
Jess (Oncall): prod embed/vec endpoints spiking 503s, rolling kvcache eviction fix ready in image redwood/inference:kvc-fix-1.2.3. need expedited deploy, traffic is affected for ~5% of requests
Matt: on it. can you paste the minimal rollback plan?
Jess (Oncall): rollback is image revert to redwood/inference:stable-1.2.2 + traffic-shift to eu-west1 fallback pool. quick runbook in PR.
Sasha: what's the blast radius? which customer traffic?
Jess (Oncall): mostly low-latency mix on embeddings; eu and us-east bursts. estimated 1-2% error budget burn, but trending up.
Anya (PM): we need at least ops + eng lead signoff. i can +1 from product if SLO mitigation is in place.
Lee (SRE): ops checklist ok. will monitor p95/p99 and circuit-breaker alerts.
Matt: i'm +1 for expedited, but prefer staged rollout. can we do a fast canary (1%) then immediate 10% if green?
Jess (Oncall): timeline: 0m canary push, 3m health check, then 10m ramp. if any 5xx spike >0.5% rollback.
Sasha: approve from eng-ml? this touches KV cache semantics.
Matt: pinging @sasha explicitly — Sasha?
Sasha: i reviewed PR, diff shows guard clause and eviction threshold tweak. tests pass. +1.
deploybot: Deploy request received: image=redwood/inference:kvc-fix-1.2.3 target=prod requested_by=Jess (Oncall) release-window=immediate bypass_canary=false
Jess (Oncall): can we bypass canary? traffic is user-impacting but we want safety. prefer staged but expedite window is tight. any objections to skip explicit canary hold if ops approves?
Lee (SRE): no bypass. do staged but shorten checks: canary 60s, health checks 180s, ramp if green.
Anya (PM): product +1 to staged short-canary. customer comms ready if we need incident update.
Matt: ok calling it. ops and eng lead signed. go for staged rollout.
Jess (Oncall): kicking deploy now. command:
```
/deploybot deploy --image redwood/inference:kvc-fix-1.2.3 --env=prod --canary=1% --ramp=10% --health-check=3m --rollback-on=5xx>0.5%
```
deploybot: Starting deploy: id=deploy-6295012345k image=redwood/inference:kvc-fix-1.2.3 canary=1%
deploybot: Canary health: OK (latency stable, 5xx=0.02%)
Jess (Oncall): canary green, ramping to 10%
deploybot: Ramp to 10% complete. health: 5xx=0.06% p99+10ms
Sasha: watching key metrics, KV eviction counters look correct.
Matt: monitoring logs for unexpected OOMs or GC stalls.
Lee (SRE): creating short-lived alert if 5xx >0.5% in any region.
deploybot: Deploy complete: 10% rollout successful. scheduled follow-up check at +30m
Anya (PM): filing a short release note + customer impact note if we have to notify customers.
Jess (Oncall): thanks team. will keep channel updated. if anything spikes we rollback to stable-1.2.2 with this cmd:
```
/deploybot rollback --to-image redwood/inference:stable-1.2.2 --traffic-shift=100% --reason="503 spike rollback"
```
Matt: noted. thanks. :thumbsup:
Sasha: nice quick turnaround. :rocket:
Jess (Oncall): marking incident as mitigated provisional, will await 30m stable window then close.
